Making Japanese curry? 🍛  Don’t just chop everything into random sizes. The way you cut your vegetables actually matters, especially if you want them nicely cooked and not disappear in curry. 🥕 𝐂𝐚𝐫𝐫𝐨𝐭 → rangiri cut Cutting it into irregular rolling pieces gives you different surfaces while keeping the pieces relatively similar in size, so they cook evenly. 🥔 𝐏𝐨𝐭𝐚𝐭𝐨 → bite-size chunks Not too small, so they have enough structure to hold their shape while becoming tender. 🧅 𝐎𝐧𝐢𝐨𝐧 → wedges Keeping the onion in wedges allows it to soften and become sweet without completely disappearing into the curry. It’s a small step, but proper cutting makes a difference in cooking time, texture and how your curry comes together. Ragi and Coconut Sheera   Ingredients:  1 Tbsp spoon Ragi 1 Tbsp dessicated coconut 1 Tsp ghee Water Jaggery powder according to taste Almonds for garnishing. Method: Roast Ragi powderwithout ghee in an iron pot for 4-5 minutes till it changes colour. Once done add coconut and ghee and roast for 2 more minutes. Add boiling water as per your likeable consistency and let it boil. Then add little jaggery powder and dish out. Serve with Almonds on top.  Enjoy and sleep nice after this.#ragi #coconut #lowiron #bettersleep #dinner
